verdict.rationale: Smooth ships an official, first-party CLI aimed at AI-native workflows. It is documented at docs.smooth.sh/cli, with integration guides for Claude Code, OpenClaw and other agents, plus CLI feature pages covering localhost tunneling, data extraction, authentication, files and live view. The official GitHub repo also describes the Smooth CLI as a browser for AI agents. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of CLI usage (community comments discuss the product generally, not the CLI's operation), and no evidence of the CLI's command reference or installation.
